2610.10332.title: Learning to Act with Task Progress: Distilling Small Agents from Compact Teacher Supervision
2610.10332.paper_summary: Learning from large-model demonstrations offers a way to train small agents that can complete recurring tasks without calling a large model at every step. A central design choice is what to retain from teacher trajectories that contain reasoning, actions, and information about task progress. We introduce Task-Progress Distillation (TPD), an offline approach that pairs each demonstrated action with a short label describing the current task stage. The student learns these compact targets and selects actions by jointly scoring admissible stage--action pairs, which a deterministic harness executes in the environment. On ALFWorld, a 1.7B student trained with 404 demonstrations achieves 72.4\% mean unseen task success with either TPD or action-only supervision, compared with 48.3\% for a reasoning-trained student using constrained action selection. Explicit stages provide an additional benefit at 200 demonstrations, improving success from 48.0\% to 67.7\% over action-only supervision. With more demonstrations, the action-only student closes the gap, and both approaches reach 76.9\% at 808 demonstrations. Shared-history analyses link part of TPD's local advantage to better decisions when moving between subgoals, particularly from object acquisition to processing. These results show that compact supervision can train effective small task agents, while explicit task progress provides additional guidance at an intermediate demonstration budget.
2610.10332.paper_summary_zh: 從大型模型示範中學習提供了一種訓練小型代理的方法，這些代理可以在不在每一步都調用大型模型的情況下完成重複任務。<lb/>一個核心設計選擇是從包含推理、行動和任務進展信息的教師軌跡中保留什麼。<lb/>我們引入了任務進展蒸餾（Task-Progress Distillation, TPD），這是一種離線方法，將每個示範行動與描述當前任務階段的簡短標籤配對。<lb/>學生學習這些緊湊的目標，並通過共同評分可接受的階段-行動對來選擇行動，這些行動由確定性裝置在環境中執行。<lb/>在 ALFWorld 上，一個訓練了 404 次示範的 1.7B 學生，在使用 TPD 或僅行動監督的情況下達到了 72.4\% 的平均未見任務成功率，而使用受限行動選擇的推理訓練學生則為 48.3\%。<lb/>在 200 次示範中，明確的階段提供了額外的好處，成功率從 48.0\% 提高到 67.7\%，超過了僅行動監督。<lb/>隨著示範次數的增加，僅行動的學生縮小了差距，兩種方法在 808 次示範中都達到了 76.9\%。<lb/>共享歷史分析將 TPD 的局部優勢的一部分與在子目標之間移動時做出更好決策聯繫起來，特別是從物體獲取到處理的過程。<lb/>這些結果表明，緊湊的監督可以訓練有效的小型任務代理，而明確的任務進展在中間示範預算下提供了額外的指導。
